scope: P03 DM general Jacobian, synchronous matrix, and origin only; no positive-state Fourier spectrum or normality theorem

software.sympy: not required; original validation environment had no SymPy installed

exact.arithmetic: exact integer sparse polynomials and Fraction Gaussian elimination

identities.general: Direct canonical common-denominator quotient differentiation equals additive Kronecker Jacobian at every entry.
identities.origin_eigenvalues: lambda_m=a-g+c exp(-2 pi i m/n); root-of-unity shift orientation checked exactly
identities.homogeneous: J=dI+CP+GP^(-q)-HP^q; generic symbolic r, denominator multiplier (1+r)^4
identities.spectral_abscissa_certificate: For c>0, Re(lambda_m)<=a-g+c; equality iff the unit root exp(-2 pi i m/n)=1, hence m=0. This elementary inequality is proof-level mathematics, not a floating test.
identities.nonuniform_zero_off_boundary: Even n: at a-g=c, the alternating mode m=n/2 has zero eigenvalue; this is away from mu=0.
